title: stachys palustris subsp. aspera
intro: Stachys palustris subsp. aspera, commonly known as Rough Woundwort, is a subspecies of the Stachys palustris plant, which is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including relief from digestive issues, reduction of inflammation, and improvement of respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Rough Woundwort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
